Reporting note

Prepared 26 October 2026. This report covers work documented through October; some initiatives began earlier. Status labels distinguish submissions, delivered activities and plans.

Introduction · 00

Executive snapshot

October 2026 Work Report records academic and institutional contributions by Dr. Sohel Rana at MVJ College of Engineering, Bengaluru. The portfolio covers proposals and intellectual property, student-oriented web portals, graduation-day digitisation, IQAC evidence management, research submission, academic planning, faculty development and accreditation documentation. It is an evidence-led work summary, not a claim that every listed initiative began or finished in October.

Core focus areas

  • Research & innovation
  • Student-centric digital learning
  • Institutional automation
  • IQAC & accreditation readiness
  • Faculty capacity building

Resource Person · Human-in-the-Loop AI

Hands-on faculty session · 24 October 2026
Delivered

Delivered a hands-on session on “Human-in-the-Loop AI” within the MOOC “Sustainable Human-in-the-Loop AI for Teachers’ Well-Being”, organised by the Faculty of Education, Guru Kashi University, in collaboration with UNESCO’s Open Education for a Better World Online Mentoring Program 2026.

The event poster describes AI-assisted e-content creation and free web hosting using GitHub. The portfolio records participation from India and international attendees.

Much more is underway for MVJCE.

Building an integrated roadmap for academic excellence, institutional ERP modernisation, digital teaching, e-studio infrastructure and evidence-based NAAC/NBA quality improvements.

✦
Next-phase proposals and continuous improvement

These are intended initiatives and proposed deliverables. Their implementation, scope and milestones are subject to institutional discussions, approvals, resources and priorities.

01SOPs & full ERP proposal

Integrated MVJCE ERP — Institutional Blueprint

Prepare a comprehensive proposal for a unified institutional ERP, with clearly defined SOPs, responsibilities, approval chains and interoperable departmental workflows.

  • Admissions, academics, attendance, assessment, examinations and student services
  • Faculty, HR, leave, finance, assets, library, alumni and grievance workflows
  • Vendor/contract assessment, privacy, access roles, audit trails, backup and continuity
  • Module-wise phased implementation, training, cost study and review mechanism
02Digital learning programme

E-content & Subject-Wise Digital Courses

Scale subject websites and structured e-content from pilot subjects to more departments, aligned with course delivery and outcome-based education.

  • Faculty-authored notes, topic-wise micro-lectures and animation
  • CO–PO–PSO mapping, quizzes, question banks and student feedback
  • Reusable templates and periodic academic content audits
03Infrastructure proposal

MVJ E-Studio — Teaching Content Production

Propose a practical e-studio for recording faculty lectures, demonstrations, interviews, voiceovers and high-quality teaching modules.

  • Space, camera, microphone, lighting, editing and storage plan
  • Faculty booking SOP, production templates and review workflow
  • Captioned, reusable content ready for LMS/subject portal integration
04IQAC governance

Standard Operating Procedures & Quality Calendar

Develop institution-wide SOP templates, document controls, ownership matrices and a review calendar for reliable, timely academic-quality operations.

  • Process mapping, document versioning and evidence retention
  • Departmental coordinator roles and escalation workflows
  • Internal audit cycles, CAPA records and follow-up reviews
05NAAC preparedness

NAAC Readiness & Measurable Quality Targets

Establish framework-aligned data collection, gap assessments and improvement targets in consultation with the IQAC and academic departments.

  • Criterion-wise evidence matrices with verified ownership
  • Academic, student-support, research and governance improvement actions
  • Target–actual review dashboards and documentary readiness checks
06NBA preparedness

NBA OBE & Programme-Level Improvement Targets

Propose department-wise review targets for outcome-based education, course files, attainment processes and continuous improvement.

  • CO, PO and PSO mapping; attainment methodology and gap reviews
  • Faculty course-file checklists, sample evidence and peer scrutiny
  • Student performance, feedback and action-taken tracking
07Institutional analytics

Evidence Dashboards & Quality Reviews

Connect departmental data with IQAC reports where authorised, to make submissions, progress and pending actions easier to verify.

  • Criteria-wise dashboards, reporting schedules and data quality checks
  • Progress meetings with defined responsibilities and action logs
  • Controlled access and verifiable audit histories
08Capacity building

Faculty Training & Sustainable Rollout

Support faculty and coordinator adoption through demonstrations, reusable teaching templates and practical feedback-led refinements.

  • ERP and evidence-upload orientation sessions
  • E-studio workshops, AI-assisted content development and peer sharing
  • Feedback loops to continuously improve usability and quality
